definitions.full: H1000. betsah [ בֵּיצָה ] noun feminine Isa 10:14 egg (Late Hebrew id. , Arabic , Aramaic בִּיעֲתָא , ) — only Plural בֵּיצִים Deut 22:6 (twice in verse); Isa 10:14 ; construct בֵּיצֵי 59:5 ; suffix בֵּיצֶיהָ Job 39:14 , בֵּיצֵיהֶם Isa 59:5 ; — eggs 10:14 (of small bird צפור ) Deut 22:6 (twice in verse), compare Isa 10:14 (in simil.); (of ostrich רננים ) Job 39:14 ; (of great viper צפעוני ) Isa 59:5 (twice in verse) (metaphor)
